1.d3 c5 2.Nc3.strategy: Develops the knight where it eyes the d5 and e4 squares and keeps the position flexible. The c-pawn is blocked, so White settles for a restrained set-up with a kingside fianchetto instead of a quick central break.

1.d3 c5 2.Nc3 Nc6.strategy: Develops a piece and adds a second guard to d4, so White cannot easily claim that square. Black mirrors White's flexible set-up and keeps every option open for the centre.
